title: Forza Horizon 5
description: An open-world racing game set in a fictionalised Mexico, developed by Playground Games and published by Xbox Game Studios.

title: Hades
description: A roguelike action game from Supergiant Games in which the son of Hades fights his way out of the Greek underworld.

title: Celeste
description: A precision platformer from Maddy Makes Games about a young woman climbing the mountain Celeste.

title: Portal 2
description: A first-person puzzle game from Valve built around a device that creates linked portals.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
description: A turn-based 4X strategy game from Firaxis Games in which players guide a civilisation from antiquity to the modern era.

title: Stardew Valley
description: A farming and life simulation game created by ConcernedApe in which the player restores an inherited farm.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
description: An open-world action role-playing game from CD Projekt Red set in the megacity of Night City.

title: DOOM Eternal
description: A fast-paced first-person shooter from id Software and the sequel to DOOM (2016).

title: Hollow Knight
description: A hand-drawn action adventure from Team Cherry set in the ruined insect kingdom of Hallownest.

title: Cities: Skylines
description: A city-building simulation game from Colossal Order and Paradox Interactive.

title: Elden Ring
description: An open-world action role-playing game from FromSoftware set in the Lands Between.

title: Rocket League
description: A vehicular football game from Psyonix in which rocket-powered cars play matches with an oversized ball.

title: Subnautica
description: An underwater open-world survival game from Unknown Worlds Entertainment set on an ocean planet.

title: Baldur's Gate 3
description: A party-based role-playing game from Larian Studios based on Dungeons and Dragons fifth edition rules.
